auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is better than a short complicated one.
auth.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

account.title: My account
account.mfaOff: Two-step verification is off. We recommend turning it on. It is required for staff accounts.
account.mfaStaffWarning: Your role needs two-step verification before you can use staff features.
account.mfaScanTitle: Add this key to your authenticator app
account.mfaKeyHelp: Open your authenticator app, choose to add an account, and enter this key by hand. Choose the time-based option.
account.mfaCodePrompt: Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
account.mfaRecoveryWarning: If you lose your phone, each code works once. They are shown only now. Keep them somewhere safe and private.

error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
